hotel-sqlite.description: SQLite MCP server for querying and inspecting hotel room inventory, menu items, active orders, and guest records. Use for read-only inspection during development — the production system uses PostgreSQL.
hotel-sqlite.notes: Requires uv/uvx: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/. Database file is auto-created at data/hotel.db on first run. Schema migrations live in backend/src/migrations/.

fetch.description: Fetch/HTTP MCP server for simulating communication with external payment gateways (Razorpay/Stripe), OTA platform APIs (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb), and WhatsApp Business API.

filesystem.description: Filesystem MCP server scoped to logs/, data/archives/, and data/uploads/. Use for auditing order logs, reading guest request archives, and inspecting uploaded bill photos. Read-only.
